scope: Operation-level Result and Decision responses; durable record state is validated independently by records.schema.json

reason_codes.OK: Verified operation succeeded with authoritative state or bytes
reason_codes.ACCEPTED_PENDING: Validated durable request admitted for asynchronous execution
reason_codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Owner or worker provider identity failed
reason_codes.PERMISSION_DENIED: Identity authenticated but not authorized for action
reason_codes.STALE_BIBLE: Source or active bible edition/epoch is stale
reason_codes.BIBLE_CONFLICT: Violates applicable required Design or Technical Bible clause
reason_codes.OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED: Protected owner-only effect or authorized bible edit pending
reason_codes.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Same namespace/key used for different canonical request digest
reason_codes.LEASE_CONFLICT: Active exact or ancestor/descendant source lease conflict
reason_codes.LEASE_FENCED: Expired or replaced worker/source lease epoch
reason_codes.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Expected branch commit or source/asset digest mismatch
reason_codes.PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: External operation outcome uncertain pending authoritative readback
reason_codes.PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: Observed configured provider lacks required capability
reason_codes.PROVIDER_NOT_VERIFIED: Capability or effect lacks actual provider-native evidence
reason_codes.TEST_NOT_RUN: Required test not executed or trusted runner not available
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_INVALID: Untrusted, stale, forged, mismatched or missing evidence
reason_codes.REVIEW_CONFLICT: Author/reviewer lacks independence or subject lineage
reason_codes.CAPACITY_LIMIT: Configured worker, quota, time or budget limit reached
reason_codes.UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION: Method/action not available on this configured provider
reason_codes.RELEASE_BLOCKED: Required PR/deployment policy or live evidence missing

error_receipt_rule: A refused or unverified external effect never returns a success receipt_ref
release_note: R9 source-authoring worker code uses this vocabulary. P2 runs actual service-contract tests. No backwards aliases.
